text:
mira: Quick async check — landing quickstarts updates. What I did: updated Python quickstart for v1.2, added env var notes. Blocker: sample-app CI failing on mac runner. Today: triage CI and open PR for docs.

alex: thanks — can you paste the PR link? pinging @sam for mac logs.

mira: PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812 — failing step `macos-lint`. Error snippet: `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'rl_sample'`.

sam: on it. quick reproduce locally to verify packaging.

sam: repro command I ran:
```
python -m pip install -e .[sample]
python -m sample_app run --config tests/sample.yaml
```
Failure looks tied to optional fsevents dep on mac. Temporary CI workaround: set `ENV_IGNORE_FSEVENTS=true` in macos job.

alex: if workaround is safe, add it to CI and open a follow-up issue to fix packaging. also landed a tiny docs tweak: standardize heading capitalization for Dedicated in SDK guides (PR #814).

jonathan: heads-up — i'm on docs rotation this afternoon. if you need a review for PR 812 ping me before 3pm PT :eyes:.

doc-bot: Automated QA: checklist run for PR 812 — missing code block language tag in `setup.md` (line 42).

mira: thanks @doc-bot, i'll patch that. quick question: should the quickstart show `yarn start:sample` or `python -m sample_app` as the primary run instruction? current guide shows both.

alex: prefer `python -m sample_app` as primary for parity with other SDK samples; keep `yarn` as an appendix for JS users.

sam: :thumbsup: i'll update sample-app README to show both and note parity.

mira: i'll add the CI env workaround to the PR and squash. will ping here once 812 updated. blocker should be cleared if packaging fix lands.

alex: quick ops note — when you're ready for review, drop a single message in #devex with the link + @jonathan; aim to get reviews within ~6h today.

doc-bot: Automated note: scheduled docs lint run at 1732113600 UTC.
